name: PJSC Russian Aquaculture
summary: PJSC Russian Aquaculture engages in the farming and distribution of fish and caviar in the Republic of Karelia and Murmansk region, Russia. It cultivates red fish products, such as Atlantic salmon and rainbow trout. The company was formerly known as OJSC Russian Sea Group and changed its name to PJSC Russian Aquaculture in February 2015. PJSC Russian Aquaculture was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Moscow, Russia.
